preparation_checklist: Bring a photo ID every day — required at Interchange pantries; helpful elsewhere
Tell each pantry you have no kitchen and ask specifically for no-cook, ready-to-eat items
Call COA Goldin Center (414-265-7696) and Maccanon Brown (414-404-0600) before visiting — hours last verified 2024
Call Capuchin House of Peace (414-933-1300) to confirm current hours before Monday visit
Call The Gathering (414-272-4122) to confirm no appointment is needed before your first visit
Call SVdP Cross Roads (414-649-9555) and Harambee (414-249-3866) to confirm no cost and no appointment
For Ebenezer Stone pop-up (Sat 9/12): call 414-488-8070 to confirm it is an active Saturday and weather is OK
res-003 (Fresh Fixture Mobile Market) excluded — paid option, $0 budget
unmet_needs: No verified breakfast option on Sunday 9/13
No verified dinner option on Saturday 9/12 evening
No services found for Saturday 9/12 after 3 pm or Sunday 9/13 morning — call 211 for same-day help
data.explanation: Seven verified or call-to-confirm free sources cover your week. Free hot meals (The Gathering, St. Vincent de Paul) require no kitchen. Pantries are conditional on no-cook items — ask when you arrive. res-003 (paid market) is excluded at $0 budget. Confirm appointment and area requirements before each pantry visit. No services found for Saturday evening or Sunday morning; those gaps are noted.
